questions.question: 1. What is the first step in preparing a transverse section of a leaf for microscopic observation?

answers.c: Cutting a thin slice using a new razor blade

questions.question: 2. In the procedure of a stem transverse section, which stain is used to distinguish between xylem and phloem?
3. What is the purpose of placing the prepared stem transverse section in water during the experiment?

answers.a: To soften the tissue for slicing
answers.b: To keep the section hydrated during observation

questions.question: 4. After staining and mounting a root transverse section on a slide, what is the correct order for microscopic observation?

answers.a: Start with the highest magnification first
answers.b: Start with low magnification, then gradually increase
answers.c: Apply heat to the slide before observation
answers.d: Dehydrate the section with alcohol before viewing

questions.question: 5. What procedural mistake could result in poorly defined root epidermis cells in a transverse section?

answers.a: Failure to use a microtome for sectioning
answers.d: Using glycerine instead of water for mounting
